scenarios.description: Real phone reaches permitted private HTTPS without bypassing TLS warnings
Login, capture and persistent server acknowledgment
Private foreground routine cue is actually seen; not inferred from server offer
Snooze changes reminder only, not underlying deadline
Minimum Done while disconnected preserves original occurrence/time/variant on reconnect
Real day-boundary completion-based successor anchored to original reported completion
Repeat delivery of same queued ID creates one completion
Native browser restart/offline shell cache and outbox persistence
Explicit concurrent edit is held for review, not overwritten
Undo works and no personal item is shared to Family calendar
Host shutdown, session expiry and reconnect shown honestly
Lock-screen/closed-tab delivery separately classified UNSUPPORTED in this release

residual_limitations: No live email ingestion or always-on installation
